ko.title: [국제물류 #4] 세계를 좁힌 강철 상자: 컨테이너 해운은 실제로 어떻게 작동하나

segments.src: > Almost everything you buy from overseas arrived in a standard steel box, and how that box is filled, which type it is, and how it moves through a port all shape what shipping costs.
segments.tr: > 해외에서 사는 물건 거의 대부분은 표준 강철 상자에 담겨 도착하며, 그 상자를 어떻게 채우는지, 어떤 종류인지, 항구에서 어떻게 이동하는지가 운송비를 결정합니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
Before the 1950s, cargo was loaded onto ships piece by piece.
segments.tr: 1950년대 이전에는 화물을 낱개로 하나씩 배에 실었습니다.

segments.src: Sacks, barrels, and crates were stacked by hand, which was slow, expensive, and an easy target for theft.
segments.tr: 자루, 통, 상자를 손으로 쌓아 올렸기 때문에 느리고 비용이 많이 들었으며 도난에도 취약했습니다.

segments.src: In 1956 the American trucking entrepreneur Malcom McLean shipped cargo in standardized metal boxes, and the shipping container era began.
segments.tr: 1956년 미국의 트럭 운송 사업가 맬컴 맥린(Malcom McLean)이 규격화된 금속 상자에 화물을 실어 보내면서 컨테이너 해운 시대가 시작되었습니다.

segments.src: Today, standard sizes let the same box travel by ship, train, and truck without anyone unpacking it.
segments.tr: 오늘날에는 표준 규격 덕분에 같은 상자를 아무도 풀어내지 않고 배, 기차, 트럭으로 옮길 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This is called **intermodal** transport.
**The standard sizes**
Containers are measured in **TEU** (twenty-foot equivalent unit).
segments.tr: 컨테이너의 크기는 **TEU**(20피트 환산 단위, twenty-foot equivalent unit)로 측정합니다.

segments.src: One 20-foot container is 1 TEU, and one 40-foot container is 2 TEU (also called an FEU).
The largest ships today carry more than 20,000 TEU.
segments.tr: 오늘날 가장 큰 선박은 20,000 TEU가 넘는 컨테이너를 실을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Approximate internal volumes:
20-ft standard (20GP)     ~33 cubic meters  (~1,170 cu ft)
40-ft standard (40GP)     ~67 cubic meters  (~2,390 cu ft)
40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller
segments.tr: 40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller

segments.src: **Container types: matching the box to the cargo**
- **Dry van (general purpose):** the ordinary enclosed box, used for clothing, electronics, furniture, and similar goods.
segments.tr: - **드라이 밴(범용):** 일반적인 밀폐형 상자로, 의류, 전자제품, 가구 등 같은 종류의 화물에 씁니다.

segments.src: - **Reefer (refrigerated):** has its own cooling unit that plugs into power at the terminal and on the ship. Used for produce, meat, and medicines.
segments.tr: - **리퍼(냉장/냉동):** 자체 냉동기가 있어 터미널과 선박에서 전원에 연결합니다. 농산물, 육류, 의약품 운송에 씁니다.

segments.src: - **Open top:** has a removable tarp roof so tall cargo, such as machinery, can be loaded by crane from above.
segments.tr: - **오픈 탑:** 분리 가능한 방수포 지붕이 있어 기계류처럼 키가 큰 화물도 위에서 크레인으로 실을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Flat rack:** has no side walls and sometimes no roof. Used for oversized items like boats or construction equipment.
segments.tr: - **플랫 랙:** 측벽이 없고 지붕도 없는 경우가 많습니다. 보트나 건설 장비처럼 규격을 넘는 화물에 씁니다.

segments.src: - **Tank container:** a steel tank inside a frame, used for liquids such as chemicals or food-grade oils.
segments.tr: - **탱크 컨테이너:** 프레임 안에 강철 탱크를 넣은 형태로, 화학물질이나 식품용 기름 같은 액체 화물에 씁니다.

segments.src: **FCL vs.
LCL: do you fill the box yourself?**

- **FCL (Full Container Load):** you book the whole container. It is packed and sealed at your supplier, and nobody else's cargo is inside. You pay a flat rate per container whether it is full or not.
segments.tr: - **FCL(Full Container Load, 컨테이너 단독 화물):** 컨테이너 한 개를 통째로 예약합니다. 공급업체에서 포장하고 봉인하며, 다른 사람의 화물은 들어가지 않습니다. 가득 찼는지와 관계없이 컨테이너당 정액 요금을 냅니다.

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** your goods share a container with other shippers' goods. A freight forwarder collects everything at a **CFS (Container Freight Station)**, consolidates it into one box, and separates it again at destination. You usually pay by volume or weight, whichever is greater ("W/M").
segments.tr: - **LCL(Less than Container Load, 혼재 화물):** 내 화물이 다른 화주의 화물과 한 컨테이너를 나눠 씁니다. 물류 주선업자(포워더)가 모든 화물을 **CFS(Container Freight Station, 컨테이너 화물 조작장)**에서 모아 하나의 상자로 묶고, 도착지에서 다시 분리합니다. 보통 부피와 무게 중 큰 쪽("W/M")을 기준으로 요금을 냅니다.

segments.src: LCL is cheaper for small shipments.
The trade-off is that it usually takes longer and costs more per cubic meter, and the extra handling adds some risk of damage.
segments.tr: 대신 보통 시간이 더 걸리고 세제곱미터당 비용이 더 비싸며, 추가 취급으로 파손 위험도 조금 늘어납니다.

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, once a shipment reaches somewhere around 13–15 cubic meters, a 20-foot FCL often costs about the same as LCL or less.
segments.tr: 대략적인 기준으로, 화물이 13~15세제곱미터 정도에 이르면 20피트 FCL이 LCL과 비슷하거나 더 저렴한 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: The real break-even point depends on the route and current rates.
segments.tr: 실제 손익분기점은 노선과 현재 운임에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: **Terminal operations: where the box changes hands**
A container terminal is a large, carefully choreographed parking lot for boxes:
segments.tr: 컨테이너 터미널은 상자를 위한 크고 정교하게 짜인 주차장과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Quay (ship-to-shore) cranes** lift containers on and off the vessel, often 25–35 moves per hour per crane.
segments.tr: 1. **안벽 크레인**(ship-to-shore 크레인)이 컨테이너를 선박에 싣고 내리며, 보통 크레인 한 대당 시간당 25~35회 작업합니다.

segments.src: 2. **Yard equipment**, such as straddle carriers and rubber-tired gantry cranes, stacks boxes in the **container yard** and plans where each one goes so it can be retrieved quickly.
segments.tr: 2. 스트래들 캐리어, 타이어형 겐트리 크레인 같은 **야드 장비**가 **컨테이너 야드**에 상자를 쌓고, 나중에 빠르게 꺼낼 수 있도록 각 상자의 위치를 계획합니다.

segments.src: 3. At the **gate**, trucks drop off export boxes and pick up import boxes. Documents and seals are checked here.
segments.tr: 3. **게이트**에서는 트럭이 수출 상자를 내려놓고 수입 상자를 가져갑니다. 서류와 봉인 상태도 여기서 확인합니다.

segments.src: 4. Some terminals have **on-dock rail** that loads containers directly onto trains heading inland.
segments.tr: 4. 일부 터미널에는 **안벽 철도(on-dock rail)**가 있어 내륙으로 향하는 열차에 컨테이너를 바로 실을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Time matters at the terminal.
After **free time** runs out, carriers charge **demurrage** if the container stays inside the terminal and **detention** if you keep their container outside the terminal too long.
segments.tr: **무료 반출입 기간(free time)**이 끝나면, 컨테이너가 터미널 안에 머물면 **체화료(demurrage)**를, 선사의 컨테이너를 터미널 밖에서 너무 오래 쓰면 **지체료(detention)**를 부과합니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
Imagine a small business in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic mugs from a factory in Shenzhen, China.
segments.tr: 중국 선전의 공장에서 도자기 머그잔을 수입하는, 오하이오주 컬럼버스의 한 소규모 사업체를 떠올려 봅시다.

segments.src: - **Spring order: 6 cubic meters.** That would fill less than a fifth of a 20-foot box, so the owner books **LCL**. The mugs are consolidated with other cargo in Shenzhen, sail to the **Port of Los Angeles**, are unloaded at a CFS, and travel inland by truck or rail. It takes a few extra days, but paying for 6 cubic meters is far cheaper than paying for an empty container.
segments.tr: - **봄 주문: 6세제곱미터.** 20피트 상자의 5분의 1도 안 되는 양이므로 사장은 **LCL**을 예약합니다. 머그잔은 선전에서 다른 화물과 함께 묶여 **로스앤젤레스항(Port of Los Angeles)**으로 항해하고, CFS에서 하역된 뒤 트럭이나 철도로 내륙으로 이동합니다. 며칠 더 걸리지만, 6세제곱미터 값만 내는 것이 빈 컨테이너 값을 내는 것보다 훨씬 저렴합니다.

segments.src: - **Holiday order: 30 cubic meters.** Now a **20-foot FCL** makes sense. The factory loads and seals the box itself. At the LA/Long Beach terminal, a quay crane lifts it off the ship, it is moved to an intermodal rail ramp, and a train carries it toward the Midwest. A truck delivers it to the warehouse in Columbus.
segments.tr: - **연휴 주문: 30세제곱미터.** 이제는 **20피트 FCL**이 합리적입니다. 공장이 직접 상자에 화물을 싣고 봉인합니다. LA/롱비치 터미널에서 안벽 크레인이 상자를 배에서 들어 올리고, 복합운송 철도 상하차장으로 옮기면, 열차가 중서부 방향으로 운송합니다. 트럭이 컬럼버스의 창고까지 배송합니다.

segments.src: - **The costly mistake:** the warehouse can't unload the box for a week, so the empty container isn't returned on time. A detention bill arrives, sometimes over $100 a day. Planning for free time is part of the shipping cost.
segments.tr: - **값비싼 실수:** 창고가 일주일 동안 상자를 하역하지 못해 빈 컨테이너를 제때 반납하지 못합니다. 지체료 청구서가 날아오며, 하루 100달러가 넘는 경우도 있습니다. 무료 반출입 기간을 계획하는 것도 운송비의 일부입니다.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
1. Standard containers (20 ft = 1 TEU, 40 ft = 2 TEU) let cargo move between ships, trains, and trucks without being unpacked.
segments.tr: 1. 표준 컨테이너(20피트 = 1 TEU, 40피트 = 2 TEU) 덕분에 화물을 풀지 않고도 선박, 열차, 트럭 사이를 옮길 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. FCL means you rent the whole box. LCL means you share one. Small shipments favor LCL, and larger ones usually favor FCL.
segments.tr: 2. FCL은 상자를 통째로 쓰는 것이고, LCL은 상자를 나눠 쓰는 것입니다. 소량 화물에는 LCL이, 대량 화물에는 보통 FCL이 유리합니다.

segments.src: 3. Terminals move boxes from crane to yard to gate on tight schedules, and holding containers past free time triggers demurrage or detention charges.
segments.tr: 3. 터미널은 촘촘한 일정에 따라 상자를 크레인에서 야드로, 다시 게이트로 옮기며, 무료 기간을 넘겨 컨테이너를 보유하면 체화료나 지체료가 부과됩니다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
**Q1.** A 40-foot container counts as how many TEU?
**Q2.** (O/X) In an LCL shipment, your goods are typically consolidated with other shippers' cargo at a container freight station.
segments.tr: **Q2.** (O/X) LCL 화물은 보통 컨테이너 화물 조작장에서 다른 화주의 화물과 합쳐집니다.

segments.src: **Q3.** Which container type is best for fresh strawberries traveling from Chile to Philadelphia?
segments.tr: **Q3.** 칠레에서 필라델피아로 운송되는 신선한 딸기에 가장 적합한 컨테이너 종류는 무엇일까요?

segments.src: A) Flat rack B) Reefer C) Open top D) Tank container
segments.tr: A) 플랫 랙 B) 리퍼 C) 오픈 탑 D) 탱크 컨테이너

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
- **TEU:** twenty-foot equivalent unit, the standard measure of container capacity.
segments.tr: - **TEU:** 20피트 환산 단위(twenty-foot equivalent unit). 컨테이너 용량의 표준 단위입니다.

segments.src: - **FCL / LCL:** Full Container Load (one shipper uses the whole box) vs. Less than Container Load (several shippers share a box).
segments.tr: - **FCL / LCL:** Full Container Load(한 화주가 상자 전체를 사용) 대 Less than Container Load(여러 화주가 상자를 나눠 사용).

segments.src: - **CFS (Container Freight Station):** the warehouse where LCL cargo is consolidated before shipping or separated after arrival.
segments.tr: - **CFS(Container Freight Station, 컨테이너 화물 조작장):** 선적 전에 LCL 화물을 모으거나 도착 후 분리하는 창고입니다.

segments.src: - **Intermodal transport:** moving the same container across ship, rail, and truck without unpacking the cargo.
segments.tr: - **복합운송(intermodal transport):** 화물을 풀지 않고 같은 컨테이너를 선박, 철도, 트럭으로 옮기는 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Demurrage / Detention:** fees for keeping a container past its free time, inside the terminal (demurrage) or outside it (detention).
segments.tr: - **체화료 / 지체료(Demurrage / Detention):** 무료 기간을 넘겨 컨테이너를 터미널 안(체화료) 또는 밖(지체료)에 두었을 때 내는 요금입니다.

segments.src: *Answers: Q1 – C.
A 40-foot box equals two 20-foot units, so it counts as 2 TEU (also called 1 FEU).
segments.tr: 40피트 상자는 20피트 두 개에 해당하므로 2 TEU로 계산합니다(1 FEU라고도 함).

segments.src: Q2 – O.
A forwarder combines multiple small shipments into one container at a CFS and splits them again at destination.
segments.tr: 포워더는 CFS에서 여러 소량 화물을 하나의 컨테이너로 묶고, 도착지에서 다시 나눕니다.

segments.src: Q3 – B.
Perishable produce needs controlled temperature, which is what a refrigerated (reefer) container provides.*
segments.tr: 부패하기 쉬운 농산물은 온도 관리가 필요하며, 이를 제공하는 것이 냉장(리퍼) 컨테이너입니다.*

segments.tr: - **整箱（FCL，Full Container Load）：** 你预订整个集装箱。货物由供应商包装并封箱，箱内不会有其他人的货物。无论箱子装满与否，都按每箱固定费率付费。

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** your goods share a container with other shippers' goods. A freight forwarder collects everything at a **CFS (Container Freight Station)**, consolidates it into one box, and separates it again at destination. You usually pay by volume or weight, whichever is greater ("W/M").
segments.tr: - **拼箱（LCL，Less than Container Load）：** 你的货物与其他货主的货物共用一个集装箱。货代会在 **CFS（Container Freight Station，集装箱货运站）** 集中收货，将其合并到一个箱子中，并在目的地再进行拆分。通常按体积或重量中较大者计费（"W/M"）。

segments.src: LCL is cheaper for small shipments.
segments.tr: 拼箱适合小批量货物，价格更便宜。

segments.src: The trade-off is that it usually takes longer and costs more per cubic meter, and the extra handling adds some risk of damage.
segments.tr: 但拼箱通常运输时间更长，每立方米的成本更高，而且额外的装卸操作也会增加一定的货损风险。

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, once a shipment reaches somewhere around 13–15 cubic meters, a 20-foot FCL often costs about the same as LCL or less.
segments.tr: 根据经验，当货量达到约13–15立方米时，20英尺整箱的费用通常与拼箱大致相当，甚至更低。

segments.src: The real break-even point depends on the route and current rates.
segments.tr: 实际的平衡点取决于航线和当前运价。

segments.src: **Terminal operations: where the box changes hands**
A container terminal is a large, carefully choreographed parking lot for boxes:
segments.tr: 集装箱码头是一个精心编排的大型箱子“停车场”：

segments.src: 1. **Quay (ship-to-shore) cranes** lift containers on and off the vessel, often 25–35 moves per hour per crane.
segments.tr: 1. **岸桥（船岸起重机）** 负责将集装箱吊上吊下船舶，通常每台每小时可完成25–35次作业。

segments.src: 2. **Yard equipment**, such as straddle carriers and rubber-tired gantry cranes, stacks boxes in the **container yard** and plans where each one goes so it can be retrieved quickly.
segments.tr: 2. **堆场设备**（如跨运车和轮胎式龙门起重机）负责在 **集装箱堆场** 堆放箱子，并规划每个箱子的位置，以便快速调取。

segments.src: 3. At the **gate**, trucks drop off export boxes and pick up import boxes. Documents and seals are checked here.
segments.tr: 3. 在 **闸口**，卡车卸下出口箱并提取进口箱。单证和封志也在此核验。

segments.src: 4. Some terminals have **on-dock rail** that loads containers directly onto trains heading inland.
segments.tr: 4. 部分码头设有 **码头内铁路**，可将集装箱直接装上开往内陆的列车。

segments.src: Time matters at the terminal.
After **free time** runs out, carriers charge **demurrage** if the container stays inside the terminal and **detention** if you keep their container outside the terminal too long.
segments.tr: 超过 **免堆期（free time）** 后，如果箱子滞留在码头内，船公司将收取 **滞港费（demurrage）**；如果你长时间占用船公司的箱子而未归还，则收取 **滞箱费（detention）**。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
Imagine a small business in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic mugs from a factory in Shenzhen, China.
segments.tr: 设想一下，俄亥俄州哥伦布市的一家小企业，从中国深圳的工厂进口陶瓷马克杯。

segments.src: - **Spring order: 6 cubic meters.** That would fill less than a fifth of a 20-foot box, so the owner books **LCL**. The mugs are consolidated with other cargo in Shenzhen, sail to the **Port of Los Angeles**, are unloaded at a CFS, and travel inland by truck or rail. It takes a few extra days, but paying for 6 cubic meters is far cheaper than paying for an empty container.
segments.tr: - **春季订单：6立方米。** 这还不到20英尺箱容积的五分之一，因此货主选择 **拼箱**。马克杯在深圳与其他货物拼装，运至 **洛杉矶港**，在CFS卸货后，再通过卡车或火车运往内陆。虽然多花了几天时间，但为6立方米付费远比为一个空箱付费便宜。

segments.src: - **Holiday order: 30 cubic meters.** Now a **20-foot FCL** makes sense. The factory loads and seals the box itself. At the LA/Long Beach terminal, a quay crane lifts it off the ship, it is moved to an intermodal rail ramp, and a train carries it toward the Midwest. A truck delivers it to the warehouse in Columbus.
segments.tr: - **节日订单：30立方米。** 这时 **20英尺整箱** 更合适。工厂自行装箱并封箱。在洛杉矶/长滩码头，岸桥将其从船上吊卸，转运至多式联运铁路站场，再由火车运往中西部。最后由卡车送到哥伦布市的仓库。

segments.src: - **The costly mistake:** the warehouse can't unload the box for a week, so the empty container isn't returned on time. A detention bill arrives, sometimes over $100 a day. Planning for free time is part of the shipping cost.
segments.tr: - **代价高昂的失误：** 仓库一周内都无法卸货，空箱也没能按时归还。随后收到滞箱费账单，有时每天超过100美元。为免费期做好规划，也是运输成本的一部分。

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
1. Standard containers (20 ft = 1 TEU, 40 ft = 2 TEU) let cargo move between ships, trains, and trucks without being unpacked.
segments.tr: 1. 标准集装箱（20英尺 = 1 TEU，40英尺 = 2 TEU）使货物无需拆箱即可在船舶、火车和卡车之间转运。

segments.src: 2. FCL means you rent the whole box. LCL means you share one. Small shipments favor LCL, and larger ones usually favor FCL.
segments.tr: 2. 整箱意味着你租下整个箱子，拼箱则是与他人共用一个箱子。小批量货物适合拼箱，大批量货物通常更适合整箱。

segments.src: 3. Terminals move boxes from crane to yard to gate on tight schedules, and holding containers past free time triggers demurrage or detention charges.
segments.tr: 3. 码头按紧凑的时间表将箱子从岸桥转运到堆场，再到闸口；集装箱超过免堆期滞留，就会产生滞港费或滞箱费。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
**Q1.** A 40-foot container counts as how many TEU?
segments.tr: **Q1.** 一个40英尺集装箱相当于多少 TEU？

segments.src: **Q2.** (O/X) In an LCL shipment, your goods are typically consolidated with other shippers' cargo at a container freight station.
segments.tr: **Q2.**（O/X）在拼箱运输中，你的货物通常会在集装箱货运站与其他货主的货物合并装箱。

segments.src: **Q3.** Which container type is best for fresh strawberries traveling from Chile to Philadelphia?
segments.tr: **Q3.** 从智利运往费城的新鲜草莓，最适合使用哪种集装箱类型？

segments.src: A) Flat rack B) Reefer C) Open top D) Tank container
segments.tr: A) 框架箱 B) 冷藏箱 C) 开顶箱 D) 罐式集装箱

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
- **TEU:** twenty-foot equivalent unit, the standard measure of container capacity.
segments.tr: - **TEU：** 二十英尺当量单位，集装箱容量的标准计量单位。

segments.src: - **FCL / LCL:** Full Container Load (one shipper uses the whole box) vs. Less than Container Load (several shippers share a box).
segments.tr: - **FCL / LCL：** 整箱（Full Container Load，一个货主独占整箱）与拼箱（Less than Container Load，多个货主共用一箱）。

segments.src: - **CFS (Container Freight Station):** the warehouse where LCL cargo is consolidated before shipping or separated after arrival.
segments.tr: - **CFS（Container Freight Station）：** 拼箱货物在发运前集中装箱、或到达后拆箱分拨的仓库。

segments.src: - **Intermodal transport:** moving the same container across ship, rail, and truck without unpacking the cargo.
segments.tr: - **多式联运：** 不拆箱，使同一个集装箱在船舶、铁路和卡车之间转运。

segments.src: - **Demurrage / Detention:** fees for keeping a container past its free time, inside the terminal (demurrage) or outside it (detention).
segments.tr: - **滞港费 / 滞箱费：** 超过免费期仍占用集装箱所收取的费用。在码头内占用为滞港费（demurrage），在码头外占用为滞箱费（detention）。

segments.src: *Answers: Q1 – C.
A 40-foot box equals two 20-foot units, so it counts as 2 TEU (also called 1 FEU).
segments.tr: 一个40英尺箱等于两个20英尺单位，因此计为2 TEU（也称为1 FEU）。

segments.src: Q2 – O.
A forwarder combines multiple small shipments into one container at a CFS and splits them again at destination.
segments.tr: 货代在CFS将多个小批量货物合并到一个集装箱中，并在目的地再进行拆分。

segments.src: Q3 – B.
Perishable produce needs controlled temperature, which is what a refrigerated (reefer) container provides.*
segments.tr: 易腐农产品需要受控温度，这正是冷藏（reefer）集装箱所提供的。*

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
Before the 1950s, cargo was loaded onto ships piece by piece.
segments.tr: 1950 के दशक से पहले, माल जहाज़ पर एक-एक करके लादा जाता था।

segments.src: Sacks, barrels, and crates were stacked by hand, which was slow, expensive, and an easy target for theft.
segments.tr: बोरे, बैरल और क्रेट हाथ से ढेर लगाकर रखे जाते थे, जो धीमा, महंगा और चोरी के लिए आसान निशाना था।

segments.src: In 1956 the American trucking entrepreneur Malcom McLean shipped cargo in standardized metal boxes, and the shipping container era began.
segments.tr: 1956 में अमेरिकी ट्रकिंग उद्यमी मैल्कम मैकलीन ने माल को मानकीकृत धातु के बक्सों में भेजा, और शिपिंग कंटेनर युग की शुरुआत हुई।

segments.src: Today, standard sizes let the same box travel by ship, train, and truck without anyone unpacking it.
segments.tr: आज, मानक आकारों की वजह से वही बॉक्स बिना किसी के उसे खोले जहाज़, रेल और ट्रक से यात्रा कर सकता है।

segments.src: This is called **intermodal** transport.
**The standard sizes**
Containers are measured in **TEU** (twenty-foot equivalent unit).
segments.tr: कंटेनर को **TEU** (twenty-foot equivalent unit) में मापा जाता है।

segments.src: One 20-foot container is 1 TEU, and one 40-foot container is 2 TEU (also called an FEU).
segments.tr: एक 20-फुट कंटेनर 1 TEU है, और एक 40-फुट कंटेनर 2 TEU है (जिसे FEU भी कहते हैं)।

segments.src: The largest ships today carry more than 20,000 TEU.
segments.tr: आज के सबसे बड़े जहाज़ 20,000 TEU से अधिक ले जाते हैं।

segments.src: Approximate internal volumes:
20-ft standard (20GP)     ~33 cubic meters  (~1,170 cu ft)
40-ft standard (40GP)     ~67 cubic meters  (~2,390 cu ft)

segments.tr: 40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller

segments.src: **Container types: matching the box to the cargo**
segments.tr: **कंटेनर के प्रकार: बॉक्स को माल के अनुसार चुनना**

segments.src: - **Dry van (general purpose):** the ordinary enclosed box, used for clothing, electronics, furniture, and similar goods.
segments.tr: - **Dry van (सामान्य उद्देश्य):** साधारण बंद बॉक्स, जो कपड़ों, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, फर्नीचर और इसी तरह के सामान के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है।

segments.src: - **Reefer (refrigerated):** has its own cooling unit that plugs into power at the terminal and on the ship. Used for produce, meat, and medicines.
segments.tr: - **Reefer (रेफ्रिजरेटेड):** इसमें अपनी कूलिंग यूनिट होती है, जो टर्मिनल और जहाज़ पर बिजली से जुड़ती है। इसका उपयोग उपज, मांस और दवाओं के लिए होता है।

segments.src: - **Open top:** has a removable tarp roof so tall cargo, such as machinery, can be loaded by crane from above.
segments.tr: - **Open top:** इसमें हटाने योग्य टारपोलिन की छत होती है, ताकि मशीनरी जैसे लंबे माल को क्रेन से ऊपर से लादा जा सके।

segments.src: - **Flat rack:** has no side walls and sometimes no roof. Used for oversized items like boats or construction equipment.
segments.tr: - **Flat rack:** इसमें कोई साइड दीवार नहीं होती और कभी-कभी छत भी नहीं होती। इसका उपयोग नाव या निर्माण उपकरण जैसी बड़े आकार की वस्तुओं के लिए होता है।

segments.src: - **Tank container:** a steel tank inside a frame, used for liquids such as chemicals or food-grade oils.
segments.tr: - **Tank container:** फ्रेम के भीतर एक स्टील टैंक, जिसका उपयोग रसायन या खाद्य-श्रेणी के तेल जैसे तरल पदार्थों के लिए होता है।

segments.src: **FCL vs.
LCL: do you fill the box yourself?**
segments.tr: LCL: क्या आप बॉक्स खुद भरते हैं?**

segments.src: - **FCL (Full Container Load):** you book the whole container. It is packed and sealed at your supplier, and nobody else's cargo is inside. You pay a flat rate per container whether it is full or not.
segments.tr: - **FCL (Full Container Load):** आप पूरा कंटेनर बुक करते हैं। यह आपके सप्लायर के यहाँ भरा और सील किया जाता है, और उसमें किसी और का माल नहीं होता। कंटेनर भरा हो या न हो, आप प्रति कंटेनर एक तय दर चुकाते हैं।

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** your goods share a container with other shippers' goods. A freight forwarder collects everything at a **CFS (Container Freight Station)**, consolidates it into one box, and separates it again at destination. You usually pay by volume or weight, whichever is greater ("W/M").
segments.tr: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** आपका माल दूसरे शिपरों के माल के साथ एक कंटेनर साझा करता है। फ्रेट फॉरवर्डर सारा माल **CFS (Container Freight Station)** पर इकट्ठा करता है, उसे एक बॉक्स में समेकित करता है, और गंतव्य पर फिर अलग करता है। आप आमतौर पर आयतन या वज़न, जो भी अधिक हो ("W/M"), उसके हिसाब से भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: LCL is cheaper for small shipments.
segments.tr: छोटी शिपमेंट के लिए LCL सस्ता होता है।

segments.src: The trade-off is that it usually takes longer and costs more per cubic meter, and the extra handling adds some risk of damage.
segments.tr: इसकी कीमत यह है कि इसमें आमतौर पर अधिक समय लगता है और प्रति घन मीटर लागत ज़्यादा होती है, और अतिरिक्त हैंडलिंग से नुकसान का जोखिम भी कुछ बढ़ जाता है।

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, once a shipment reaches somewhere around 13–15 cubic meters, a 20-foot FCL often costs about the same as LCL or less.
segments.tr: मोटे तौर पर एक नियम के तौर पर, जब शिपमेंट लगभग 13–15 घन मीटर तक पहुँच जाती है, तो 20-फुट FCL की लागत अक्सर LCL के बराबर या उससे कम होती है।

segments.src: The real break-even point depends on the route and current rates.
segments.tr: असली ब्रेक-ईवन बिंदु रूट और मौजूदा दरों पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: **Terminal operations: where the box changes hands**
segments.tr: **टर्मिनल संचालन: बॉक्स कहाँ हाथ बदलता है**

segments.src: A container terminal is a large, carefully choreographed parking lot for boxes:
segments.tr: कंटेनर टर्मिनल बक्सों के लिए एक बड़ा, सावधानी से कोरियोग्राफ़ किया गया पार्किंग स्थल होता है:

segments.src: 1. **Quay (ship-to-shore) cranes** lift containers on and off the vessel, often 25–35 moves per hour per crane.
segments.tr: 1. **क्वे (ship-to-shore) क्रेन** जहाज़ से कंटेनर उतारती और चढ़ाती हैं, अक्सर प्रति क्रेन प्रति घंटे 25–35 मूव।

segments.src: 2. **Yard equipment**, such as straddle carriers and rubber-tired gantry cranes, stacks boxes in the **container yard** and plans where each one goes so it can be retrieved quickly.
segments.tr: 2. **यार्ड उपकरण**, जैसे straddle carriers और रबर-टायर्ड गैन्ट्री क्रेन, **कंटेनर यार्ड** में बक्से लगाते हैं और योजना बनाते हैं कि हर बॉक्स कहाँ जाएगा, ताकि उसे जल्दी निकाला जा सके।

segments.src: 3. At the **gate**, trucks drop off export boxes and pick up import boxes. Documents and seals are checked here.
segments.tr: 3. **गेट** पर, ट्रक निर्यात वाले बॉक्स छोड़ते हैं और आयात वाले बॉक्स उठाते हैं। दस्तावेज़ और सील यहाँ जाँचे जाते हैं।

segments.src: 4. Some terminals have **on-dock rail** that loads containers directly onto trains heading inland.
segments.tr: 4. कुछ टर्मिनलों में **on-dock rail** होती है, जो कंटेनरों को सीधे अंतर्देशीय जाने वाली ट्रेनों पर लादती है।

segments.src: Time matters at the terminal.
segments.tr: टर्मिनल पर समय मायने रखता है।

segments.src: After **free time** runs out, carriers charge **demurrage** if the container stays inside the terminal and **detention** if you keep their container outside the terminal too long.
segments.tr: **free time** खत्म होने के बाद, अगर कंटेनर टर्मिनल के भीतर रहता है तो वाहक **demurrage** वसूलते हैं, और अगर आप उनका कंटेनर टर्मिनल के बाहर भी बहुत देर तक रखते हैं तो **detention** लगता है।

Imagine a small business in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic mugs from a factory in Shenzhen, China.
segments.tr: कल्पना कीजिए कि ओहायो के कोलंबस में एक छोटा व्यवसाय चीन के शेनझेन की एक फैक्ट्री से सिरेमिक मग आयात करता है।

es.title: [Logística internacional #4] La caja de acero que encogió el mundo: cómo funciona realmente el transporte en contenedores

segments.src: > Almost everything you buy from overseas arrived in a standard steel box, and how that box is filled, which type it is, and how it moves through a port all shape what shipping costs.
segments.tr: > Casi todo lo que compras del extranjero llega en una caja de acero estándar, y cómo se llena esa caja, de qué tipo es y cómo se mueve por un puerto determina lo que cuesta el envío.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
Before the 1950s, cargo was loaded onto ships piece by piece.
segments.tr: Antes de la década de 1950, la carga se subía a los buques pieza por pieza.

segments.src: Sacks, barrels, and crates were stacked by hand, which was slow, expensive, and an easy target for theft.
segments.tr: Sacos, barriles y cajas se apilaban a mano, lo cual era lento, caro y un blanco fácil para el robo.

segments.src: In 1956 the American trucking entrepreneur Malcom McLean shipped cargo in standardized metal boxes, and the shipping container era began.
segments.tr: En 1956 el empresario estadounidense de transporte por camión Malcom McLean envió carga en cajas metálicas estandarizadas, y comenzó la era del contenedor de transporte.

segments.src: Today, standard sizes let the same box travel by ship, train, and truck without anyone unpacking it.
segments.tr: Hoy, los tamaños estándar permiten que la misma caja viaje en barco, tren y camión sin que nadie la desempaque.

segments.src: This is called **intermodal** transport.
**The standard sizes**
Containers are measured in **TEU** (twenty-foot equivalent unit).
segments.tr: Los contenedores se miden en **TEU** (unidad equivalente a veinte pies).

segments.src: One 20-foot container is 1 TEU, and one 40-foot container is 2 TEU (also called an FEU).
segments.tr: Una caja de 20 pies equivale a 1 TEU, y una de 40 pies equivale a 2 TEU (también llamado FEU).

segments.src: The largest ships today carry more than 20,000 TEU.
segments.tr: Los buques más grandes de hoy transportan más de 20,000 TEU.

segments.src: Approximate internal volumes:
20-ft standard (20GP)     ~33 cubic meters  (~1,170 cu ft)
40-ft standard (40GP)     ~67 cubic meters  (~2,390 cu ft)
40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller
segments.tr: 40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller

segments.src: **Container types: matching the box to the cargo**
segments.tr: **Tipos de contenedor: elegir la caja según la carga**

segments.src: - **Dry van (general purpose):** the ordinary enclosed box, used for clothing, electronics, furniture, and similar goods.
segments.tr: - **Dry van (uso general):** la caja cerrada común, usada para ropa, electrónica, muebles y mercancías similares.

segments.src: - **Reefer (refrigerated):** has its own cooling unit that plugs into power at the terminal and on the ship. Used for produce, meat, and medicines.
segments.tr: - **Reefer (refrigerado):** tiene su propia unidad de refrigeración que se conecta a la corriente en la terminal y en el buque. Se usa para productos agrícolas, carne y medicamentos.

segments.src: - **Open top:** has a removable tarp roof so tall cargo, such as machinery, can be loaded by crane from above.
segments.tr: - **Open top (techo abierto):** tiene una lona desmontable como techo, de modo que la carga alta, como maquinaria, puede cargarse desde arriba con grúa.

segments.src: - **Flat rack:** has no side walls and sometimes no roof. Used for oversized items like boats or construction equipment.
segments.tr: - **Flat rack (plataforma):** no tiene paredes laterales y a veces tampoco techo. Se usa para artículos de gran tamaño, como embarcaciones o equipo de construcción.

segments.src: - **Tank container:** a steel tank inside a frame, used for liquids such as chemicals or food-grade oils.
segments.tr: - **Tank container (cisterna):** un tanque de acero dentro de un bastidor, usado para líquidos como productos químicos o aceites de calidad alimentaria.

segments.src: **FCL vs.
LCL: do you fill the box yourself?**

- **FCL (Full Container Load):** you book the whole container. It is packed and sealed at your supplier, and nobody else's cargo is inside. You pay a flat rate per container whether it is full or not.
segments.tr: - **FCL (Full Container Load):** reservas el contenedor completo. Se empaca y precinta en tu proveedor, y no hay carga de nadie más dentro. Pagas una tarifa fija por contenedor, esté lleno o no.

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** your goods share a container with other shippers' goods. A freight forwarder collects everything at a **CFS (Container Freight Station)**, consolidates it into one box, and separates it again at destination. You usually pay by volume or weight, whichever is greater ("W/M").
segments.tr: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** tus mercancías comparten contenedor con las de otros remitentes. Un agente de carga recoge todo en una **CFS (Container Freight Station)**, lo consolida en una sola caja y lo vuelve a separar en destino. Normalmente se paga por volumen o peso, lo que sea mayor («W/M»).

segments.src: LCL is cheaper for small shipments.
segments.tr: LCL es más barato para envíos pequeños.

segments.src: The trade-off is that it usually takes longer and costs more per cubic meter, and the extra handling adds some risk of damage.
segments.tr: La contrapartida es que suele tardar más y cuesta más por metro cúbico, y la manipulación adicional añade cierto riesgo de daños.

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, once a shipment reaches somewhere around 13–15 cubic meters, a 20-foot FCL often costs about the same as LCL or less.
segments.tr: Como regla orientativa, cuando un envío alcanza alrededor de 13–15 metros cúbicos, un FCL de 20 pies suele costar lo mismo que el LCL o menos.

segments.src: The real break-even point depends on the route and current rates.
segments.tr: El punto de equilibrio real depende de la ruta y de las tarifas vigentes.

segments.src: **Terminal operations: where the box changes hands**
segments.tr: **Operaciones en la terminal: donde la caja cambia de manos**

segments.src: A container terminal is a large, carefully choreographed parking lot for boxes:
segments.tr: Una terminal de contenedores es un gran estacionamiento para cajas, cuidadosamente coreografiado:

segments.src: 1. **Quay (ship-to-shore) cranes** lift containers on and off the vessel, often 25–35 moves per hour per crane.
segments.tr: 1. **Grúas de muelle (buque a tierra)** cargan y descargan contenedores del buque, a menudo 25–35 movimientos por hora y por grúa.

segments.src: 2. **Yard equipment**, such as straddle carriers and rubber-tired gantry cranes, stacks boxes in the **container yard** and plans where each one goes so it can be retrieved quickly.
segments.tr: 2. **Equipos de patio**, como los straddle carriers y las grúas pórtico de neumáticos, apilan cajas en el **patio de contenedores** y planifican dónde va cada una para poder recuperarla rápidamente.

segments.src: 3. At the **gate**, trucks drop off export boxes and pick up import boxes. Documents and seals are checked here.
segments.tr: 3. En la **puerta**, los camiones dejan las cajas de exportación y recogen las de importación. Aquí se revisan los documentos y los precintos.

segments.src: 4. Some terminals have **on-dock rail** that loads containers directly onto trains heading inland.
segments.tr: 4. Algunas terminales tienen **vía férrea en el muelle** que carga los contenedores directamente en trenes con destino al interior.

segments.src: Time matters at the terminal.
segments.tr: El tiempo importa en la terminal.

segments.src: After **free time** runs out, carriers charge **demurrage** if the container stays inside the terminal and **detention** if you keep their container outside the terminal too long.
segments.tr: Cuando se agota el **periodo libre**, las navieras cobran **demurrage** (sobrestadía) si el contenedor permanece dentro de la terminal, y **detention** (detención) si mantienes su contenedor fuera de la terminal durante demasiado tiempo.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
Imagine a small business in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic mugs from a factory in Shenzhen, China.
segments.tr: Imagina una pequeña empresa en Columbus, Ohio, que importa tazas de cerámica de una fábrica en Shenzhen, China.

The mugs are consolidated with other cargo in Shenzhen, sail to the **Port of Los Angeles**, are unloaded at a CFS, and travel inland by truck or rail. It takes a few extra days, but paying for 6 cubic meters is far cheaper than paying for an empty container.

Las tazas se consolidan con otra carga en Shenzhen, zarpan hacia el **Puerto de Los Ángeles**, se descargan en una CFS y viajan al interior por camión o tren. Tarda unos días más, pero pagar 6 metros cúbicos es mucho más barato que pagar un contenedor vacío.

segments.src: - **Holiday order: 30 cubic meters.** Now a **20-foot FCL** makes sense. The factory loads and seals the box itself. At the LA/Long Beach terminal, a quay crane lifts it off the ship, it is moved to an intermodal rail ramp, and a train carries it toward the Midwest. A truck delivers it to the warehouse in Columbus.
segments.tr: - **Pedido de temporada festiva: 30 metros cúbicos.** Ahora tiene sentido un **FCL de 20 pies**. La fábrica carga y precinta la caja. En la terminal de LA/Long Beach, una grúa de muelle la levanta del buque, se traslada a una rampa ferroviaria intermodal y un tren la lleva hacia el Medio Oeste. segments.src: - **Reefer (refrigerated):** has its own cooling unit that plugs into power at the terminal and on the ship. Used for produce, meat, and medicines.
segments.tr: - **حاوية مبردة (Reefer):** تحتوي على وحدة تبريد خاصة بها تُوصل بمصدر الكهرباء في المحطة وعلى السفينة. تُستخدم للمنتجات الزراعية واللحوم والأدوية.

segments.src: - **Open top:** has a removable tarp roof so tall cargo, such as machinery, can be loaded by crane from above.
segments.tr: - **حاوية مفتوحة السقف:** لها سقف من قماش مشمّع قابل للإزالة، فيمكن تحميل البضائع الطويلة، مثل الآلات، بالرافعة من الأعلى.

segments.src: - **Flat rack:** has no side walls and sometimes no roof. Used for oversized items like boats or construction equipment.
segments.tr: - **منصة مسطحة (Flat rack):** لا تحتوي على جدران جانبية، وأحيانًا لا تحتوي على سقف. تُستخدم للبضائع كبيرة الحجم مثل القوارب أو معدات البناء.

segments.src: - **Tank container:** a steel tank inside a frame, used for liquids such as chemicals or food-grade oils.

segments.src: **FCL vs.
LCL: do you fill the box yourself?**

- **FCL (Full Container Load):** you book the whole container. It is packed and sealed at your supplier, and nobody else's cargo is inside. You pay a flat rate per container whether it is full or not.
segments.tr: - **FCL (حمولة حاوية كاملة):** تحجز الحاوية بالكامل. تُعبَّأ وتُختم لدى المورد، ولا توجد بداخلها بضائع أي شخص آخر. تدفع سعرًا ثابتًا عن كل حاوية سواء كانت ممتلئة أم لا.

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** your goods share a container with other shippers' goods. A freight forwarder collects everything at a **CFS (Container Freight Station)**, consolidates it into one box, and separates it again at destination. You usually pay by volume or weight, whichever is greater ("W/M").
segments.tr: - **LCL (حمولة أقل من حاوية كاملة):** تشارك بضائعك حاوية مع بضائع شاحنين آخرين. يجمع وكيل الشحن كل البضائع في **CFS (محطة شحن الحاويات)**، ويدمجها في صندوق واحد، ثم يفصلها مجددًا عند الوجهة. وعادةً ما تدفع وفقًا للحجم أو الوزن، أيهما أكبر ("W/M").

segments.src: LCL is cheaper for small shipments.
The trade-off is that it usually takes longer and costs more per cubic meter, and the extra handling adds some risk of damage.
segments.tr: لكن المقابل أنها عادةً تستغرق وقتًا أطول وتكلّف أكثر لكل متر مكعب، كما أن المناولة الإضافية تزيد احتمال التلف.

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, once a shipment reaches somewhere around 13–15 cubic meters, a 20-foot FCL often costs about the same as LCL or less.
segments.tr: وكقاعدة تقريبية، عندما تصل الشحنة إلى نحو 13–15 مترًا مكعبًا، غالبًا ما تكلّف حاوية FCL بطول 20 قدمًا قريبًا من تكلفة LCL أو أقل.

segments.src: The real break-even point depends on the route and current rates.
segments.tr: أما نقطة التعادل الفعلية فتعتمد على المسار والأسعار السارية.

segments.src: **Terminal operations: where the box changes hands**
segments.tr: **عمليات المحطة: المكان الذي تنتقل فيه الحاوية بين الأطراف**

segments.src: A container terminal is a large, carefully choreographed parking lot for boxes:
segments.tr: محطة الحاويات ساحة انتظار واسعة للصناديق تُدار بتنسيق دقيق:

segments.src: 1. **Quay (ship-to-shore) cranes** lift containers on and off the vessel, often 25–35 moves per hour per crane.
segments.tr: 1. **رافعات الرصيف (من السفينة إلى البر)** ترفع الحاويات إلى السفينة وتنزلها منها، وغالبًا بمعدل 25–35 حركة في الساعة لكل رافعة.

segments.src: 2. **Yard equipment**, such as straddle carriers and rubber-tired gantry cranes, stacks boxes in the **container yard** and plans where each one goes so it can be retrieved quickly.
segments.tr: 2. **معدات الساحة**، مثل الناقلات الفوقية والرافعات البوابية المطاطية، تكدّس الصناديق في **ساحة الحاويات** وتخطط لمكان كل حاوية لتسهيل استرجاعها بسرعة.

segments.src: 3. At the **gate**, trucks drop off export boxes and pick up import boxes. Documents and seals are checked here.
segments.tr: 3. عند **البوابة**، تُسلّم الشاحنات حاويات التصدير وتستلم حاويات الاستيراد. وتُفحص المستندات والأختام هنا.

segments.src: 4. Some terminals have **on-dock rail** that loads containers directly onto trains heading inland.
segments.tr: 4. تملك بعض المحطات **سكة حديد على الرصيف** تحمّل الحاويات مباشرةً على القطارات المتجهة إلى الداخل.

segments.src: Time matters at the terminal.
After **free time** runs out, carriers charge **demurrage** if the container stays inside the terminal and **detention** if you keep their container outside the terminal too long.
segments.tr: بعد انتهاء **الوقت المجاني**، تفرض شركات الملاحة **غرامة التأخير داخل المحطة (Demurrage)** إذا بقيت الحاوية داخل المحطة، و**غرامة الاحتجاز (Detention)** إذا أبقيت حاويتهم خارج المحطة لمدة طويلة.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
Imagine a small business in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic mugs from a factory in Shenzhen, China.
segments.tr: تخيّل شركة صغيرة في كولومبوس بولاية أوهايو، تستورد أكواب سيراميك من مصنع في شنزن بالصين.

segments.src: - **Spring order: 6 cubic meters.** That would fill less than a fifth of a 20-foot box, so the owner books **LCL**. The mugs are consolidated with other cargo in Shenzhen, sail to the **Port of Los Angeles**, are unloaded at a CFS, and travel inland by truck or rail. It takes a few extra days, but paying for 6 cubic meters is far cheaper than paying for an empty container.
segments.tr: - **طلب الربيع: 6 أمتار مكعبة.** هذه الكمية تملأ أقل من خُمس حاوية بطول 20 قدمًا، لذا يحجز المالك **LCL**. تُجمَّع الأكواب مع بضائع أخرى في شنزن، ثم تُبحر إلى **ميناء لوس أنجلوس**، وتُفرَّغ في CFS، وتنتقل إلى الداخل بالشاحنة أو القطار. يستغرق ذلك بضعة أيام إضافية، لكن الدفع مقابل 6 أمتار مكعبة أرخص بكثير من الدفع مقابل حاوية فارغة.

segments.src: - **Holiday order: 30 cubic meters.** Now a **20-foot FCL** makes sense. The factory loads and seals the box itself. At the LA/Long Beach terminal, a quay crane lifts it off the ship, it is moved to an intermodal rail ramp, and a train carries it toward the Midwest. A truck delivers it to the warehouse in Columbus.
segments.tr: - **طلب العطلات: 30 مترًا مكعبًا.** هنا يصبح **FCL بطول 20 قدمًا** منطقيًا. يقوم المصنع بتحميل الصندوق وختمه بنفسه. في محطة لوس أنجلوس/لونغ بيتش ترفعه رافعة الرصيف من السفينة، ثم يُنقل إلى منحدر سكة حديد متعدد الوسائط، ويحمله قطار نحو الغرب الأوسط. وتوصله شاحنة إلى المستودع في كولومبوس.

segments.src: - **The costly mistake:** the warehouse can't unload the box for a week, so the empty container isn't returned on time. A detention bill arrives, sometimes over $100 a day. Planning for free time is part of the shipping cost.
segments.tr: - **الخطأ المكلف:** لا يستطيع المستودع تفريغ الصندوق لمدة أسبوع، لذلك لا تُعاد الحاوية الفارغة في موعدها. تصل فاتورة الاحتجاز، وأحيانًا تتجاوز 100 دولار يوميًا. وتخطيط الوقت المجاني جزء من تكلفة الشحن.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
1. Standard containers (20 ft = 1 TEU, 40 ft = 2 TEU) let cargo move between ships, trains, and trucks without being unpacked.
segments.tr: 1. تتيح الحاويات القياسية (20 قدمًا = 1 TEU، و40 قدمًا = 2 TEU) نقل البضائع بين السفن والقطارات والشاحنات دون فكّ تعبئتها.

segments.src: 2. FCL means you rent the whole box. LCL means you share one. Small shipments favor LCL, and larger ones usually favor FCL.
segments.tr: 2. تعني FCL أنك تستأجر الصندوق كاملًا، وتعني LCL أنك تشارك في صندوق. تناسب الشحنات الصغيرة LCL، وتناسب الشحنات الأكبر عادةً FCL.

segments.src: 3. Terminals move boxes from crane to yard to gate on tight schedules, and holding containers past free time triggers demurrage or detention charges.
segments.tr: 3. تنقل المحطات الصناديق من الرافعة إلى الساحة ثم إلى البوابة وفق جداول دقيقة، وتؤدي إطالة بقاء الحاويات بعد الوقت المجاني إلى رسوم demurrage أو detention.

segments.src: - **FCL / LCL:** Full Container Load (one shipper uses the whole box) vs. Less than Container Load (several shippers share a box).
segments.tr: - **FCL / LCL:** حمولة حاوية كاملة (يستخدم شاحن واحد الصندوق بالكامل) مقابل حمولة أقل من حاوية كاملة (يشترك عدة شاحنين في صندوق).

segments.src: - **CFS (Container Freight Station):** the warehouse where LCL cargo is consolidated before shipping or separated after arrival.
segments.tr: - **CFS (محطة شحن الحاويات):** المستودع الذي تُجمَّع فيه بضائع LCL قبل الشحن أو تُفصل فيه بعد الوصول.

segments.src: - **Demurrage / Detention:** fees for keeping a container past its free time, inside the terminal (demurrage) or outside it (detention).
segments.tr: - **Demurrage / Detention:** رسوم بقاء الحاوية بعد انتهاء وقتها المجاني، داخل المحطة (demurrage) أو خارجها (detention).

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
Before the 1950s, cargo was loaded onto ships piece by piece.

segments.src: Sacks, barrels, and crates were stacked by hand, which was slow, expensive, and an easy target for theft.
segments.tr: Sacs, fûts et caisses étaient empilés à la main, ce qui était lent, coûteux et facilement victime de vols.

segments.src: In 1956 the American trucking entrepreneur Malcom McLean shipped cargo in standardized metal boxes, and the shipping container era began.

segments.src: Today, standard sizes let the same box travel by ship, train, and truck without anyone unpacking it.

pt.title: [Logística Internacional #4] A caixa de aço que encolheu o mundo: como o transporte em contêineres realmente funciona

segments.src: > Almost everything you buy from overseas arrived in a standard steel box, and how that box is filled, which type it is, and how it moves through a port all shape what shipping costs.
segments.tr: > Quase tudo o que você compra do exterior chegou em uma caixa de aço padrão, e a forma como essa caixa é preenchida, o tipo dela e o modo como passa pelo porto influenciam o custo do frete.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
Before the 1950s, cargo was loaded onto ships piece by piece.
segments.tr: Antes dos anos 1950, a carga era embarcada navio a navio, peça por peça.

segments.src: Sacks, barrels, and crates were stacked by hand, which was slow, expensive, and an easy target for theft.
segments.tr: Sacas, barris e caixotes eram empilhados à mão, o que era lento, caro e um alvo fácil para roubos.

segments.src: In 1956 the American trucking entrepreneur Malcom McLean shipped cargo in standardized metal boxes, and the shipping container era began.
segments.tr: Em 1956, o empreendedor americano do setor de transporte rodoviário Malcom McLean transportou carga em caixas metálicas padronizadas, e começou a era dos contêineres de transporte.

segments.src: Today, standard sizes let the same box travel by ship, train, and truck without anyone unpacking it.
segments.tr: Hoje, os tamanhos padronizados permitem que a mesma caixa viaje de navio, trem e caminhão sem que ninguém precise desembalá-la.

segments.src: This is called **intermodal** transport.
**The standard sizes**
Containers are measured in **TEU** (twenty-foot equivalent unit).
segments.tr: Os contêineres são medidos em **TEU** (twenty-foot equivalent unit, unidade equivalente a vinte pés).

segments.src: One 20-foot container is 1 TEU, and one 40-foot container is 2 TEU (also called an FEU).
segments.tr: Um contêiner de 20 pés equivale a 1 TEU, e um de 40 pés equivale a 2 TEU (também chamado de FEU).

segments.src: The largest ships today carry more than 20,000 TEU.
segments.tr: Os maiores navios atuais transportam mais de 20.000 TEU.

segments.src: Approximate internal volumes:
20-ft standard (20GP)     ~33 cubic meters  (~1,170 cu ft)
40-ft standard (40GP)     ~67 cubic meters  (~2,390 cu ft)
40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller
segments.tr: 40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller

segments.src: **Container types: matching the box to the cargo**
segments.tr: **Tipos de contêiner: escolhendo a caixa certa para a carga**

segments.src: - **Dry van (general purpose):** the ordinary enclosed box, used for clothing, electronics, furniture, and similar goods.
segments.tr: - **Dry van (uso geral):** o contêiner fechado comum, usado para roupas, eletrônicos, móveis e produtos semelhantes.

segments.src: - **Reefer (refrigerated):** has its own cooling unit that plugs into power at the terminal and on the ship. Used for produce, meat, and medicines.
segments.tr: - **Reefer (refrigerado):** possui unidade de refrigeração própria, que é ligada à energia no terminal e no navio. Usado para hortifrúti, carnes e medicamentos.

segments.src: - **Open top:** has a removable tarp roof so tall cargo, such as machinery, can be loaded by crane from above.
segments.tr: - **Open top (teto aberto):** tem uma lona removível no teto, para que cargas altas, como máquinas, possam ser carregadas por guindaste pelo alto.

segments.src: - **Flat rack:** has no side walls and sometimes no roof. Used for oversized items like boats or construction equipment.
segments.tr: - **Flat rack (plataforma):** não tem paredes laterais e, às vezes, não tem teto. Usado para itens de dimensões especiais, como barcos ou equipamentos de construção.

segments.src: - **Tank container:** a steel tank inside a frame, used for liquids such as chemicals or food-grade oils.
segments.tr: - **Tank container (tanque):** um tanque de aço dentro de uma estrutura, usado para líquidos como produtos químicos ou óleos de grau alimentício.

segments.src: **FCL vs.
LCL: do you fill the box yourself?**
segments.tr: LCL: você mesmo preenche a caixa?**

segments.src: - **FCL (Full Container Load):** you book the whole container. It is packed and sealed at your supplier, and nobody else's cargo is inside. You pay a flat rate per container whether it is full or not.
segments.tr: - **FCL (Full Container Load, carga completa de contêiner):** você reserva o contêiner inteiro. Ele é embalado e lacrado pelo seu fornecedor, e não há carga de outros embarcadores dentro. Você paga uma tarifa fixa por contêiner, esteja ele cheio ou não.

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** your goods share a container with other shippers' goods. A freight forwarder collects everything at a **CFS (Container Freight Station)**, consolidates it into one box, and separates it again at destination. You usually pay by volume or weight, whichever is greater ("W/M").
segments.tr: - **LCL (Less than Container Load, carga fracionada):** suas mercadorias dividem o contêiner com as de outros embarcadores. Um agente de carga reúne tudo em um **CFS (Container Freight Station, estação de consolidação de contêineres)**, consolida em uma só caixa e separa novamente no destino. Normalmente você paga pelo volume ou pelo peso, o que for maior ("W/M").

segments.src: LCL is cheaper for small shipments.
segments.tr: A LCL é mais barata para embarques pequenos.

segments.src: The trade-off is that it usually takes longer and costs more per cubic meter, and the extra handling adds some risk of damage.
segments.tr: A desvantagem é que costuma levar mais tempo e custar mais por metro cúbico, e o manuseio extra acrescenta algum risco de avaria.

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, once a shipment reaches somewhere around 13–15 cubic meters, a 20-foot FCL often costs about the same as LCL or less.
segments.tr: Como regra prática, quando o embarque chega a algo em torno de 13 a 15 metros cúbicos, um FCL de 20 pés costuma custar o mesmo que a LCL ou menos.

segments.src: The real break-even point depends on the route and current rates.
segments.tr: O ponto de equilíbrio real depende da rota e das tarifas vigentes.

segments.src: **Terminal operations: where the box changes hands**
segments.tr: **Operações no terminal: onde a caixa muda de mãos**

segments.src: A container terminal is a large, carefully choreographed parking lot for boxes:
segments.tr: Um terminal de contêineres é um grande pátio de estacionamento de caixas, com operações altamente coordenadas:

segments.src: 1. **Quay (ship-to-shore) cranes** lift containers on and off the vessel, often 25–35 moves per hour per crane.
segments.tr: 1. **Guindastes de cais (ship-to-shore)** içam os contêineres do navio e o descarregam, muitas vezes com 25 a 35 movimentos por hora por guindaste.

segments.src: 2. **Yard equipment**, such as straddle carriers and rubber-tired gantry cranes, stacks boxes in the **container yard** and plans where each one goes so it can be retrieved quickly.
segments.tr: 2. **Equipamentos de pátio**, como os straddle carriers e os guindastes pórtico sobre pneus, empilham as caixas no **pátio de contêineres** e planejam onde cada uma fica, para que possa ser recuperada rapidamente.

segments.src: 3. At the **gate**, trucks drop off export boxes and pick up import boxes. Documents and seals are checked here.
segments.tr: 3. No **portão**, os caminhões deixam os contêineres de exportação e retiram os de importação. Documentos e lacres são conferidos aqui.

segments.src: 4. Some terminals have **on-dock rail** that loads containers directly onto trains heading inland.
segments.tr: 4. Alguns terminais têm **ferrovia no próprio cais**, que carrega os contêineres diretamente em trens com destino ao interior.

segments.src: Time matters at the terminal.
After **free time** runs out, carriers charge **demurrage** if the container stays inside the terminal and **detention** if you keep their container outside the terminal too long.
segments.tr: Quando o **período livre** se esgota, as transportadoras cobram **demurrage** se o contêiner permanecer dentro do terminal, e **detention** se você mantiver o contêiner deles fora do terminal por tempo demais.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
Imagine a small business in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic mugs from a factory in Shenzhen, China.
segments.tr: Imagine uma pequena empresa em Columbus, Ohio, que importa canecas de cerâmica de uma fábrica em Shenzhen, na China.

segments.src: - **Spring order: 6 cubic meters.** That would fill less than a fifth of a 20-foot box, so the owner books **LCL**. The mugs are consolidated with other cargo in Shenzhen, sail to the **Port of Los Angeles**, are unloaded at a CFS, and travel inland by truck or rail. It takes a few extra days, but paying for 6 cubic meters is far cheaper than paying for an empty container.
segments.tr: - **Pedido de primavera: 6 metros cúbicos.** Isso ocuparia menos de um quinto de uma caixa de 20 pés, então o dono reserva **LCL**. As canecas são consolidadas com outras cargas em Shenzhen, navegam até o **Porto de Los Angeles**, são descarregadas em uma CFS e seguem para o interior por caminhão ou trem. Leva alguns dias a mais, mas pagar por 6 metros cúbicos é muito mais barato do que pagar por um contêiner vazio.

segments.src: - **Holiday order: 30 cubic meters.** Now a **20-foot FCL** makes sense. The factory loads and seals the box itself. At the LA/Long Beach terminal, a quay crane lifts it off the ship, it is moved to an intermodal rail ramp, and a train carries it toward the Midwest. A truck delivers it to the warehouse in Columbus.
segments.tr: - **Pedido de fim de ano: 30 metros cúbicos.** Agora um **FCL de 20 pés** faz sentido. A fábrica carrega e lacra a caixa. No terminal de Los Angeles/Long Beach, um guindaste de cais a retira do navio, ela é levada a uma rampa ferroviária intermodal e um trem a transporta em direção ao Meio-Oeste. Um caminhão a entrega no armazém em Columbus.

segments.src: - **The costly mistake:** the warehouse can't unload the box for a week, so the empty container isn't returned on time. A detention bill arrives, sometimes over $100 a day. Planning for free time is part of the shipping cost.
segments.tr: - **O erro caro:** o armazém não consegue descarregar a caixa por uma semana, então o contêiner vazio não é devolvido no prazo. Chega uma cobrança de detention, às vezes acima de US$ 100 por dia. Planejar o período livre faz parte do custo do frete.

segments.tr: Sebagai patokan kasar, begitu pengiriman mencapai sekitar 13–15 meter kubik, FCL 20 kaki sering kali berbiaya sama dengan LCL atau lebih murah.

segments.src: The real break-even point depends on the route and current rates.
segments.tr: Titik impas sebenarnya bergantung pada rute dan tarif yang berlaku.

segments.src: **Terminal operations: where the box changes hands**
A container terminal is a large, carefully choreographed parking lot for boxes:
segments.tr: Terminal kontainer adalah area parkir besar untuk kotak yang diatur dengan sangat cermat:

segments.src: 1. **Quay (ship-to-shore) cranes** lift containers on and off the vessel, often 25–35 moves per hour per crane.
segments.tr: 1. **Quay crane (crane dermaga ke kapal)** mengangkat kontainer naik dan turun dari kapal, sering kali 25–35 pergerakan per jam per crane.

segments.src: 2. **Yard equipment**, such as straddle carriers and rubber-tired gantry cranes, stacks boxes in the **container yard** and plans where each one goes so it can be retrieved quickly.
segments.tr: 2. **Peralatan lapangan**, seperti straddle carrier dan rubber-tired gantry crane, menumpuk kotak di **container yard** dan merencanakan posisi setiap kotak agar dapat diambil dengan cepat.

segments.src: 3. At the **gate**, trucks drop off export boxes and pick up import boxes. Documents and seals are checked here.
segments.tr: 3. Di **gate**, truk menurunkan kotak ekspor dan mengambil kotak impor. Dokumen dan segel diperiksa di sini.

segments.src: 4. Some terminals have **on-dock rail** that loads containers directly onto trains heading inland.
segments.tr: 4. Beberapa terminal memiliki **on-dock rail** yang memuat kontainer langsung ke kereta menuju daratan.

segments.src: Time matters at the terminal.
After **free time** runs out, carriers charge **demurrage** if the container stays inside the terminal and **detention** if you keep their container outside the terminal too long.
segments.tr: Setelah **free time** habis, operator pelayaran mengenakan **demurrage** jika kontainer tetap berada di dalam terminal dan **detention** jika kontainer milik mereka Anda simpan terlalu lama di luar terminal.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
Imagine a small business in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic mugs from a factory in Shenzhen, China.
segments.tr: Bayangkan sebuah usaha kecil di Columbus, Ohio, yang mengimpor cangkir keramik dari pabrik di Shenzhen, Tiongkok.

segments.src: - **Spring order: 6 cubic meters.** That would fill less than a fifth of a 20-foot box, so the owner books **LCL**. The mugs are consolidated with other cargo in Shenzhen, sail to the **Port of Los Angeles**, are unloaded at a CFS, and travel inland by truck or rail. It takes a few extra days, but paying for 6 cubic meters is far cheaper than paying for an empty container.
segments.tr: - **Pesanan musim semi: 6 meter kubik.** Jumlah itu kurang dari seperlima kotak 20 kaki, jadi pemilik memesan **LCL**. Cangkir digabung dengan kargo lain di Shenzhen, berlayar ke **Port of Los Angeles**, dibongkar di CFS, dan dibawa ke daratan dengan truk atau kereta. Prosesnya butuh beberapa hari tambahan, tetapi membayar 6 meter kubik jauh lebih murah daripada membayar kontainer kosong.

segments.src: - **Holiday order: 30 cubic meters.** Now a **20-foot FCL** makes sense. The factory loads and seals the box itself. At the LA/Long Beach terminal, a quay crane lifts it off the ship, it is moved to an intermodal rail ramp, and a train carries it toward the Midwest. A truck delivers it to the warehouse in Columbus.
segments.tr: - **Pesanan liburan: 30 meter kubik.** Sekarang **FCL 20 kaki** masuk akal. Pabrik memuat dan menyegel kotaknya sendiri. Di terminal LA/Long Beach, quay crane mengangkatnya dari kapal, kotak dipindahkan ke rampa kereta intermodal, dan kereta membawanya ke arah Midwest. Truk mengantarkannya ke gudang di Columbus.

segments.src: - **The costly mistake:** the warehouse can't unload the box for a week, so the empty container isn't returned on time. A detention bill arrives, sometimes over $100 a day. Planning for free time is part of the shipping cost.
segments.tr: - **Kesalahan yang mahal:** gudang tidak dapat membongkar kotak selama seminggu, sehingga kontainer kosong tidak dikembalikan tepat waktu. Tagihan detention pun datang, kadang lebih dari $100 per hari. Merencanakan free time adalah bagian dari biaya pengiriman.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
1. Standard containers (20 ft = 1 TEU, 40 ft = 2 TEU) let cargo move between ships, trains, and trucks without being unpacked.
segments.tr: 1. Kontainer standar (20 kaki = 1 TEU, 40 kaki = 2 TEU) memungkinkan kargo berpindah antara kapal, kereta, dan truk tanpa dibongkar.

segments.src: 2. FCL means you rent the whole box. LCL means you share one. Small shipments favor LCL, and larger ones usually favor FCL.
segments.tr: 2. FCL berarti Anda menyewa seluruh kotak. LCL berarti Anda berbagi satu kotak. Pengiriman kecil cenderung memilih LCL, dan pengiriman yang lebih besar umumnya memilih FCL.

segments.src: 3. Terminals move boxes from crane to yard to gate on tight schedules, and holding containers past free time triggers demurrage or detention charges.
segments.tr: 3. Terminal memindahkan kotak dari crane ke lapangan hingga gate sesuai jadwal ketat, dan menahan kontainer melewati free time memicu biaya demurrage atau detention.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.tr: **Q1.** Kontainer 40 kaki dihitung sebagai berapa TEU?

segments.tr: **Q2.** (O/X) Dalam pengiriman LCL, barang Anda biasanya digabung dengan kargo pengirim lain di container freight station.

segments.src: **Q3.** Which container type is best for fresh strawberries traveling from Chile to Philadelphia?
segments.tr: **Q3.** Jenis kontainer apa yang paling cocok untuk stroberi segar yang dikirim dari Chile ke Philadelphia?

segments.tr: A) Flat rack B) Reefer C) Open top D) Tank container

segments.tr: - **TEU:** twenty-foot equivalent unit, ukuran standar kapasitas kontainer.

segments.tr: - **FCL / LCL:** Full Container Load (satu pengirim menggunakan seluruh kotak) vs. Less than Container Load (beberapa pengirim berbagi satu kotak).

ja.title: [International Logistics #4] 世界を縮めた鋼鉄の箱：コンテナ輸送は実際どう機能するのか

segments.src: > Almost everything you buy from overseas arrived in a standard steel box, and how that box is filled, which type it is, and how it moves through a port all shape what shipping costs.
segments.tr: > ほぼすべての海外製品は標準的な鋼鉄製コンテナで届きます。その箱にどう積むか、どの種類か、港でどう動くかが、輸送コストを左右します。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
Before the 1950s, cargo was loaded onto ships piece by piece.
segments.tr: 1950年代以前、貨物は一つずつ船に積み込まれていました。

segments.src: Sacks, barrels, and crates were stacked by hand, which was slow, expensive, and an easy target for theft.
segments.tr: 袋、樽、木箱は手作業で積み上げられ、時間もコストもかかり、盗難の標的にもなりやすいものでした。

segments.src: In 1956 the American trucking entrepreneur Malcom McLean shipped cargo in standardized metal boxes, and the shipping container era began.
segments.tr: 1956年、アメリカの陸運起業家マルコム・マクリーンが貨物を規格化された金属製の箱で輸送し、コンテナ輸送の時代が始まりました。

segments.src: Today, standard sizes let the same box travel by ship, train, and truck without anyone unpacking it.
segments.tr: 今日では、規格サイズのおかげで、誰も中身を取り出すことなく、同じ箱を船・列車・トラックで運ぶことができます。

segments.src: This is called **intermodal** transport.
segments.tr: これを**複合一貫輸送（インターモーダル輸送）**と呼びます。

segments.src: **The standard sizes**
Containers are measured in **TEU** (twenty-foot equivalent unit).
segments.tr: コンテナは **TEU**（twenty-foot equivalent unit、20フィート換算単位）で測られます。

segments.src: One 20-foot container is 1 TEU, and one 40-foot container is 2 TEU (also called an FEU).
segments.tr: 20フィートコンテナは1 TEU、40フィートコンテナは2 TEU（FEUとも呼ばれます）です。

segments.src: The largest ships today carry more than 20,000 TEU.
segments.tr: 現在最大の船は20,000 TEUを超える積載能力を持っています。

segments.src: Approximate internal volumes:
20-ft standard (20GP)     ~33 cubic meters  (~1,170 cu ft)
40-ft standard (40GP)     ~67 cubic meters  (~2,390 cu ft)
40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller
segments.tr: 40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller

segments.src: **Container types: matching the box to the cargo**
segments.tr: **コンテナの種類：貨物に合わせた箱選び**

segments.src: - **Dry van (general purpose):** the ordinary enclosed box, used for clothing, electronics, furniture, and similar goods.
segments.tr: - **ドライコンテナ（汎用）：** 一般的な密閉型の箱で、衣料、電子機器、家具などに使われます。

segments.src: - **Reefer (refrigerated):** has its own cooling unit that plugs into power at the terminal and on the ship. Used for produce, meat, and medicines.
segments.tr: - **リーファー（冷凍・冷蔵）：** 独自の冷却装置を備え、ターミナルや船上で電源に接続します。青果、肉、医薬品に使われます。

segments.src: - **Open top:** has a removable tarp roof so tall cargo, such as machinery, can be loaded by crane from above.
segments.tr: - **オープントップ：** 取り外し可能な防水シートの屋根があり、機械類など背の高い貨物を上からクレーンで積み込めます。

segments.src: - **Flat rack:** has no side walls and sometimes no roof. Used for oversized items like boats or construction equipment.
segments.tr: - **フラットラック：** 側壁がなく、屋根がない場合もあります。ボートや建設機械などの大型貨物に使われます。

segments.src: - **Tank container:** a steel tank inside a frame, used for liquids such as chemicals or food-grade oils.
segments.tr: - **タンクコンテナ：** フレームの中に鋼鉄製のタンクを組み込んだもので、化学品や食品用油などの液体に使われます。

segments.src: **FCL vs.
LCL: do you fill the box yourself?**
segments.tr: LCL：箱は自分で満たすのか？**

segments.src: - **FCL (Full Container Load):** you book the whole container. It is packed and sealed at your supplier, and nobody else's cargo is inside. You pay a flat rate per container whether it is full or not.
segments.tr: - **FCL（コンテナ満載貨物）：** コンテナ1本を丸ごと予約します。仕入先で梱包・封印され、他の荷主の貨物は入りません。コンテナが満載かどうかにかかわらず、コンテナ単位の定額料金を支払います。

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** your goods share a container with other shippers' goods. A freight forwarder collects everything at a **CFS (Container Freight Station)**, consolidates it into one box, and separates it again at destination. You usually pay by volume or weight, whichever is greater ("W/M").
segments.tr: - **LCL（コンテナ混載貨物）：** 自社の貨物を他の荷主の貨物と同じコンテナに混載します。フレイトフォワーダーが**CFS（コンテナ・フレイト・ステーション）**で全ての貨物を集め、1つの箱にまとめ、目的地で再び仕分けします。通常は容積か重量のどちらか大きい方（「W/M」）で支払います。

segments.src: LCL is cheaper for small shipments.
segments.tr: LCLは小口貨物には安くつきます。

segments.src: The trade-off is that it usually takes longer and costs more per cubic meter, and the extra handling adds some risk of damage.
segments.tr: ただし一般に輸送に時間がかかり、立方メートル当たりの費用も高くなり、積み替えの手間の分だけ破損リスクも増えます。

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, once a shipment reaches somewhere around 13–15 cubic meters, a 20-foot FCL often costs about the same as LCL or less.
segments.tr: おおまかな目安として、貨物量がおよそ13〜15立方メートルに達すると、20フィートFCLの費用はLCLと同程度か、それより安くなることが多いです。

segments.src: The real break-even point depends on the route and current rates.
segments.tr: 実際の損益分岐点は、航路と現在の運賃によって変わります。

segments.src: **Terminal operations: where the box changes hands**
segments.tr: **ターミナルでの作業：箱が手渡される場所**

segments.src: A container terminal is a large, carefully choreographed parking lot for boxes:
segments.tr: コンテナターミナルは、箱のための大規模で緻密に振り付けられた駐車場のようなものです：

segments.src: 1. **Quay (ship-to-shore) cranes** lift containers on and off the vessel, often 25–35 moves per hour per crane.
segments.tr: 1. **岸壁（ship-to-shore）クレーン**がコンテナを船に積み降ろしします。クレーン1台あたり1時間に25〜35回の作業が行われることが多いです。

segments.src: 2. **Yard equipment**, such as straddle carriers and rubber-tired gantry cranes, stacks boxes in the **container yard** and plans where each one goes so it can be retrieved quickly.
segments.tr: 2. **ヤード機材**（ストラドルキャリアーやタイヤ式ガントリークレーンなど）が**コンテナヤード**に箱を積み上げ、素早く取り出せるよう各箱の配置を計画します。

segments.src: 3. At the **gate**, trucks drop off export boxes and pick up import boxes. Documents and seals are checked here.
segments.tr: 3. **ゲート**では、トラックが輸出用の箱を降ろし、輸入用の箱を引き取ります。書類とシールはここで確認されます。

segments.src: 4. Some terminals have **on-dock rail** that loads containers directly onto trains heading inland.
segments.tr: 4. 一部のターミナルには、内陸へ向かう列車に直接コンテナを積み込める**オンドックレール**があります。

segments.src: Time matters at the terminal.
segments.tr: ターミナルでは時間が重要です。

segments.src: After **free time** runs out, carriers charge **demurrage** if the container stays inside the terminal and **detention** if you keep their container outside the terminal too long.
segments.tr: **フリータイム**が終わると、コンテナがターミナル内に残っている場合は**デマレージ（滞留料）**、コンテナを長くターミナル外に置いたままにすると**ディテンション（使用料）**が課されます。

Imagine a small business in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic mugs from a factory in Shenzhen, China.

de.title: [International Logistics #4] Die Stahlbox, die die Welt schrumpfen ließ: Wie Containerschifffahrt wirklich funktioniert

segments.src: > Almost everything you buy from overseas arrived in a standard steel box, and how that box is filled, which type it is, and how it moves through a port all shape what shipping costs.
segments.tr: > Fast alles, was Sie aus dem Ausland kaufen, kam in einer standardisierten Stahlbox an. Wie diese Box beladen wird, welcher Typ sie ist und wie sie durch einen Hafen bewegt wird, bestimmt maßgeblich die Versandkosten.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
Before the 1950s, cargo was loaded onto ships piece by piece.
segments.tr: Vor den 1950er-Jahren wurde Fracht Stück für Stück auf Schiffe geladen.

segments.src: Sacks, barrels, and crates were stacked by hand, which was slow, expensive, and an easy target for theft.
segments.tr: Säcke, Fässer und Kisten wurden von Hand gestapelt, was langsam, teuer und ein leichtes Ziel für Diebstahl war.

segments.src: In 1956 the American trucking entrepreneur Malcom McLean shipped cargo in standardized metal boxes, and the shipping container era began.
segments.tr: 1956 transportierte der amerikanische Lkw-Unternehmer Malcom McLean Fracht in standardisierten Metallboxen, und das Zeitalter des Schiffscontainers begann.

segments.src: Today, standard sizes let the same box travel by ship, train, and truck without anyone unpacking it.
segments.tr: Heute ermöglichen standardisierte Maße, dass dieselbe Box per Schiff, Bahn und Lkw reist, ohne dass jemand sie auspackt.

segments.src: This is called **intermodal** transport.
**The standard sizes**
Containers are measured in **TEU** (twenty-foot equivalent unit).
segments.tr: Container werden in **TEU** (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit) gemessen.

segments.src: One 20-foot container is 1 TEU, and one 40-foot container is 2 TEU (also called an FEU).
segments.tr: Ein 20-Fuß-Container entspricht 1 TEU, ein 40-Fuß-Container 2 TEU (auch FEU genannt).

segments.src: The largest ships today carry more than 20,000 TEU.
segments.tr: Die größten heutigen Schiffe transportieren mehr als 20.000 TEU.

segments.src: Approximate internal volumes:
20-ft standard (20GP)     ~33 cubic meters  (~1,170 cu ft)
40-ft standard (40GP)     ~67 cubic meters  (~2,390 cu ft)
40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller
segments.tr: 40-ft high cube (40HC)    ~76 cubic meters  (~2,700 cu ft), about 1 ft taller

segments.src: **Container types: matching the box to the cargo**
segments.tr: **Containertypen: die Box passend zur Ladung wählen**

segments.src: - **Dry van (general purpose):** the ordinary enclosed box, used for clothing, electronics, furniture, and similar goods.
segments.tr: - **Dry Van (Universalcontainer):** der gewöhnliche geschlossene Container für Kleidung, Elektronik, Möbel und ähnliche Waren.

segments.src: - **Reefer (refrigerated):** has its own cooling unit that plugs into power at the terminal and on the ship. Used for produce, meat, and medicines.
segments.tr: - **Reefer (Kühlcontainer):** verfügt über ein eigenes Kühlaggregat, das am Terminal und an Bord an die Stromversorgung angeschlossen wird. Verwendet für Frischware, Fleisch und Medikamente.

segments.src: - **Open top:** has a removable tarp roof so tall cargo, such as machinery, can be loaded by crane from above.
segments.tr: - **Open Top:** hat ein abnehmbares Planendach, sodass sperrige Ladung wie Maschinen von oben per Kran beladen werden kann.

segments.src: - **Flat rack:** has no side walls and sometimes no roof. Used for oversized items like boats or construction equipment.
segments.tr: - **Flat Rack:** hat keine Seitenwände und manchmal kein Dach. Verwendet für übergroße Güter wie Boote oder Baugeräte.

segments.src: - **Tank container:** a steel tank inside a frame, used for liquids such as chemicals or food-grade oils.
segments.tr: - **Tankcontainer:** ein Stahltank in einem Rahmen, verwendet für Flüssigkeiten wie Chemikalien oder lebensmitteltaugliche Öle.

segments.src: **FCL vs.
LCL: do you fill the box yourself?**
segments.tr: LCL: Befüllen Sie die Box selbst?**

segments.src: - **FCL (Full Container Load):** you book the whole container. It is packed and sealed at your supplier, and nobody else's cargo is inside. You pay a flat rate per container whether it is full or not.
segments.tr: - **FCL (Full Container Load, komplette Containerladung):** Sie buchen den gesamten Container. Er wird beim Lieferanten gepackt und versiegelt, und niemand sonst hat Fracht darin. Sie zahlen einen Pauschalpreis pro Container, unabhängig davon, ob er voll ist oder nicht.

segments.src: - **LCL (Less than Container Load):** your goods share a container with other shippers' goods. A freight forwarder collects everything at a **CFS (Container Freight Station)**, consolidates it into one box, and separates it again at destination. You usually pay by volume or weight, whichever is greater ("W/M").
segments.tr: - **LCL (Less than Container Load, Teilladung):** Ihre Waren teilen sich einen Container mit Waren anderer Versender. Ein Spediteur sammelt alles in einer **CFS (Container Freight Station, Containerfreistation)**, bündelt es in einem Container und trennt es am Zielort wieder. Üblicherweise zahlen Sie nach Volumen oder Gewicht, je nachdem, was größer ist („W/M“).

segments.src: LCL is cheaper for small shipments.
segments.tr: LCL ist für kleine Sendungen günstiger.

segments.src: The trade-off is that it usually takes longer and costs more per cubic meter, and the extra handling adds some risk of damage.
segments.tr: Der Nachteil ist, dass es meist länger dauert und pro Kubikmeter mehr kostet, und die zusätzliche Handhabung birgt ein gewisses Beschädigungsrisiko.

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, once a shipment reaches somewhere around 13–15 cubic meters, a 20-foot FCL often costs about the same as LCL or less.
segments.tr: Als grobe Faustregel gilt: Ab etwa 13–15 Kubikmetern ist ein 20-Fuß-FCL oft genauso teuer wie LCL oder günstiger.

segments.src: The real break-even point depends on the route and current rates.
segments.tr: Der tatsächliche Break-even-Punkt hängt von der Route und den aktuellen Tarifen ab.

segments.src: **Terminal operations: where the box changes hands**
segments.tr: **Terminalbetrieb: wo die Box den Besitzer wechselt**

segments.src: A container terminal is a large, carefully choreographed parking lot for boxes:
segments.tr: Ein Containerterminal ist ein großer, präzise choreografierter Parkplatz für Boxen:

segments.src: 1. **Quay (ship-to-shore) cranes** lift containers on and off the vessel, often 25–35 moves per hour per crane.
segments.tr: 1. **Schiffsbrücken (Quay Cranes)** heben Container auf das Schiff und wieder herunter, oft 25–35 Umschläge pro Stunde und Kran.

segments.src: 2. **Yard equipment**, such as straddle carriers and rubber-tired gantry cranes, stacks boxes in the **container yard** and plans where each one goes so it can be retrieved quickly.
segments.tr: 2. **Yard-Equipment**, etwa Straddle Carrier und gummibereifte Portalkrane, stapelt Boxen auf dem **Containerlager** und plant, wo jede einzelne steht, damit sie schnell wieder abgerufen werden kann.

segments.src: 3. At the **gate**, trucks drop off export boxes and pick up import boxes. Documents and seals are checked here.
segments.tr: 3. Am **Tor (Gate)** bringen Lkw Exportboxen und holen Importboxen ab. Dokumente und Plomben werden hier geprüft.

segments.src: 4. Some terminals have **on-dock rail** that loads containers directly onto trains heading inland.
segments.tr: 4. Einige Terminals verfügen über **Gleisanschluss am Terminal**, über den Container direkt auf Züge ins Landesinnere verladen werden.

segments.src: Time matters at the terminal.
After **free time** runs out, carriers charge **demurrage** if the container stays inside the terminal and **detention** if you keep their container outside the terminal too long.
segments.tr: Nach Ablauf der **Freizeit (Free Time)** berechnen Reedereien **Demurrage** (Liegegebühren), wenn der Container im Terminal verbleibt, und **Detention** (Standgebühren), wenn Sie den Container außerhalb des Terminals zu lange behalten.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
Imagine a small business in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic mugs from a factory in Shenzhen, China.
segments.tr: Stellen Sie sich ein kleines Unternehmen in Columbus, Ohio vor, das Keramikbecher aus einer Fabrik in Shenzhen, China importiert.

segments.src: - **Spring order: 6 cubic meters.** That would fill less than a fifth of a 20-foot box, so the owner books **LCL**. The mugs are consolidated with other cargo in Shenzhen, sail to the **Port of Los Angeles**, are unloaded at a CFS, and travel inland by truck or rail. It takes a few extra days, but paying for 6 cubic meters is far cheaper than paying for an empty container.
segments.tr: - **Frühjahrsbestellung: 6 Kubikmeter.** Das würde weniger als ein Fünftel eines 20-Fuß-Containers füllen, daher bucht der Inhaber **LCL**. Die Becher werden in Shenzhen mit anderer Fracht gebündelt, fahren zum **Hafen von Los Angeles**, werden in einer CFS entladen und reisen per Lkw oder Bahn ins Landesinnere. Es dauert einige Tage länger, aber für 6 Kubikmeter zu zahlen ist weit günstiger, als für einen leeren Container zu zahlen.

segments.src: - **Holiday order: 30 cubic meters.** Now a **20-foot FCL** makes sense. The factory loads and seals the box itself. At the LA/Long Beach terminal, a quay crane lifts it off the ship, it is moved to an intermodal rail ramp, and a train carries it toward the Midwest. A truck delivers it to the warehouse in Columbus.
segments.tr: - **Feiertagsbestellung: 30 Kubikmeter.** Jetzt ist ein **20-Fuß-FCL** sinnvoll. Die Fabrik belädt und versiegelt die Box selbst. Am Terminal in Los Angeles/Long Beach hebt ein Schiffskran sie vom Schiff, sie wird zu einer Gleisrampe für den intermodalen Verkehr gebracht, und ein Zug transportiert sie in Richtung Mittlerer Westen. Ein Lkw liefert sie an das Lager in Columbus.

segments.src: - **The costly mistake:** the warehouse can't unload the box for a week, so the empty container isn't returned on time. A detention bill arrives, sometimes over $100 a day. Planning for free time is part of the shipping cost.
segments.tr: - **Der teure Fehler:** Das Lager kann die Box eine Woche lang nicht entladen, sodass der leere Container nicht rechtzeitig zurückgegeben wird. Es kommt eine Detention-Rechnung, manchmal über 100 $ pro Tag. Die Planung der Freizeit gehört zu den Versandkosten.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
1. Standard containers (20 ft = 1 TEU, 40 ft = 2 TEU) let cargo move between ships, trains, and trucks without being unpacked.
segments.tr: 1. Standardcontainer (20 Fuß = 1 TEU, 40 Fuß = 2 TEU) ermöglichen es, Fracht zwischen Schiff, Zug und Lkw zu bewegen, ohne sie auszupacken.

segments.src: 2. FCL means you rent the whole box. LCL means you share one. Small shipments favor LCL, and larger ones usually favor FCL.
segments.tr: 2. FCL bedeutet, dass Sie den ganzen Container mieten. LCL bedeutet, dass Sie sich einen teilen. Kleine Sendungen sprechen für LCL, größere meist für FCL.

segments.src: 3. Terminals move boxes from crane to yard to gate on tight schedules, and holding containers past free time triggers demurrage or detention charges.
segments.tr: 3. Terminals bewegen Boxen nach engen Zeitplänen vom Kran über das Lager bis zum Tor, und wer Container über die Freizeit hinaus festhält, löst Demurrage- oder Detention-Gebühren aus.
